scripts.test: docker compose -f compose.e2e.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --no-attach tabroomdb-e2e --exit-code-from e2e; code=$?; npm run report; exit $code
scripts.report: rm -rf playwright-report test-results; docker compose -f compose.e2e.yml cp e2e:/app/e2e/playwright-report ./playwright-report; docker compose -f compose.e2e.yml cp e2e:/app/e2e/test-results ./test-results || true
